correctness.rationale: By unique paths, the objective is 1+(2/(n-1)) times a pair-distance polynomial. Exhaustive Prüfer enumeration of all 18,248 labelled trees on 2–7 nodes finds a maximum-degree vertex for every tree whose competitor differences have nonnegative Bernstein coefficients exactly. For the explicit eight-node tree, exact distance profiles establish strict inequalities for every other vertex and the sign \(1-p^2-p^3\) changes precisely once. A separate exact 128-edge-state average for each of 40 choices matches the formula, with standalone checker executed successfully.

originality.rationale: The precise new assertion is a minimal-order tree crossover with an explicit sharp eight-vertex witness and an all-transmissibility finite exhaustive seven-vertex certificate. The closest fully inspected source, Holme 2017, evaluates the same single-vaccine mean on 3–7-node graphs but does not treat eight vertices; other epidemic/vaccine texts define machinery or optimize distinct models. Searches found no theorem that implies this sharp eight-node minimality classification. Negative search results alone are not proof of priority; residual risk of equivalent uninspected material is explicitly stated.
residual_risks: The full primary text of Sharkey et al and selected historical reliability-optimization sources were not exhaustively compared.
A published but poorly indexed single-vaccine tree ordering theorem could dominate the specific finite classification; independent historical-priority verification remains warranted.
The tree-specific equality of one-seed expected size across several SIR transmission formulations must not be generalized to outbreak distributions or cyclic networks.

value.rationale: The smallest order at which local degree-targeting vaccination can lose optimality to path fragmentation is a natural finite-network design boundary, not a parameter-picked special case: all smaller trees are exhaustively ruled out. The exact threshold and complete pair-distance certificate make the limitation of a common centrality heuristic clear, while the scope is confined to uniform-seed independent-edge transmission.
